summary: WCC Customer Dropdown Feature - ALL TESTS PASS. Backend APIs working correctly (9/9 tests passed). Frontend Customer dropdown implemented with data-testid='customer-dropdown', populated from Domestic Customers database. Customer selection updates customer_name and customer_address fields. WCC list displays correct customer names.

issues: Customer dropdown doesn't pre-select when existing customer_name doesn't exactly match any domestic customer name (e.g., 'Nippon Express' vs 'Nippon Express (India) Private Limited'). This is expected behavior but could be improved with fuzzy matching.

critical_code_review_comments: Customer dropdown correctly uses data-testid='customer-dropdown' for testing
settingsAPI.getDomesticClients() correctly fetches customers with customer_type=domestic filter
Backend prioritizes frontend-provided customer_name over auto-detection from project.client
customer_name is included in allowed_fields for PUT /api/work-completion/{id} endpoint
Edit mode attempts to match existing customer_name to domestic customers (case-insensitive exact match)
seed_data_creation: Used existing WCC certificates: WCC/2026/0005 (Nippon Express), WCC/2026/0004 (DSV Solutions), etc.
